title: Training-Free Action Correction for VLA Model Failures via Language Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2608.29967v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong semantic understanding yet exhibit systematic failures during deployment. The conditions under which these failures occur, and whether they can be corrected without retraining, remain poorly understood. In this paper, we take steps toward addressing this gap. We present CorrectVLA, a framework that translates task-level natural language corrections into additive action magnitude adjustments without modifying policy weights. A human provides a single task-level correction, applied uniformly across all rollouts without per-episode intervention. In simulation, CorrectVLA recovers execution misalignment failures across both in-distribution and OOD tasks. In real-robot experiments on a UFactory xArm7 under environment shift, CorrectVLA restores near-perfect success where the base policy almost entirely breaks down, generalizing across object locations and identities. translated_title: 基于语言反馈的免训练动作校正方法：解决VLA模型的失效问题
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型展现出强大的语义理解能力，但在部署过程中会出现系统性的失败。这些失败在何种条件下发生，以及能否在不重新训练的情况下加以纠正，目前仍知之甚少。本文朝着填补这一空白迈出了步伐。我们提出了CorrectVLA，这是一个将任务级自然语言纠正转化为附加动作幅度调整的框架，无需修改策略权重。人类只需提供一次任务级纠正，该纠正便统一应用于所有执行过程中，无需逐回合干预。在仿真中，CorrectVLA能够修复分布内和分布外（OOD）任务中的执行错位失败。在UFactory xArm7真实机器人的环境变化实验中，当基础策略几乎完全失效时，CorrectVLA恢复了近乎完美的成功率，并在物体位置和身份变化下展现出泛化能力。通过一个分类体系……
tldr: CorrectVLA提出了一种免训练框架，将人类单次任务级自然语言纠正转化为附加动作幅度调整，无需修改策略权重即可修复VLA模型的执行失败，并在环境变化下的真实机器人实验中恢复近乎完美的成功率。
en_tdlr: CorrectVLA is a training-free framework that translates a single human task-level natural language correction into additive action magnitude adjustments, fixing VLA model failures without modifying policy weights and restoring near-perfect success on real robots under environment shift.
